BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the judicial conduct commission; amending RCW2.64.020; and providing a contingent effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 2.64.020 and 2005 c 15 s 1 are each amended to read asfollows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The commission shall consist of ((eleven)) fourteen members.One member shall be a judge selected by and from the court of appealsjudges; ((one)) two members shall be ((a)) judges selected by and fromthe superior court judges; one member shall be a judge selected by andfrom the limited jurisdiction court judges; ((two)) three members shallbe selected by the state bar association and be admitted to thepractice of law in this state; and ((six)) seven members shall benonlawyers appointed by the governor. The term of each member of thecommission shall be four years. (2) No commission member or alternate who participates in aninvestigation or initial proceeding leading to a finding of probablecause may participate in any further proceedings on that cause,including a public hearing.

This act takes effect December 3, 2009, ifthe proposed amendment to Article IV, section 31 of the stateConstitution adding members to the judicial conduct commission isvalidly submitted to and is approved and ratified by the voters at thenext general election. If the proposed amendment is not approved andratified, this act is void in its entirety.
